title: Geyser
what: Lets Bedrock players (phones, consoles, Windows Bedrock) join this Java server.
steps: Bedrock players connect to this PC's address on Geyser's own port (19132 unless changed), not the Java port.
Install Floodgate too, so Bedrock players don't need a Java account.
Reload kicks everyone who is on, so do it when nobody is playing.

buttons.label: Read its settings again
buttons.warning: Everyone who is on gets kicked.
